questions.question: What happened to Jeremiah in chapter 37 when he tried to leave the city?
options: He escaped safely away to the far-off land of Egypt at last
He was accused of deserting to the Babylonians and imprisoned
He was welcomed back as a great hero by all of the people
He was made a chief adviser to the king in the royal court
questions.answer: He was accused of deserting to the Babylonians and imprisoned

questions.question: What did Zedekiah secretly ask Jeremiah?
options: 'Is there any word from the LORD?'
'Will you lead my army into battle?'
'Who has betrayed the city to the enemy?'
'How can I make peace with Babylon?'
questions.answer: 'Is there any word from the LORD?'

questions.question: Jeremiah told Zedekiah he would be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon.
